titles.title: Calla Lily in Tall Glass – No. 2

description: Vertical canvas of a calla lily flower in a tall clear glass vase with a green stem that reaches the length of the glass.  The flower is open leaning backwards with the yellow portion pointing straight up.  In a background of grey, with a strip of white along the left side.
